# Are security updates free for users?

Maintainers regularly ask whether the cost of producing security updates can be passed on to the people who use their software. Annex I Part II addresses how security updates are disseminated to users. The working group has not agreed a reading of every edge case, so consult Annex I Part II directly for the wording rather than relying on a summary here.

# Under which licence is this FAQ published?

# Can I translate the FAQ?

Translations are welcome. Place them in a directory named after the language code and link back to the English original from each page.
